Cross references (1) For provisions authorizing the withdrawal from the bonded premises of a distilled spirits plant of denatured distilled spirits, see section 5214(a)(1). (2) For provisions requiring a permit to procure specially denatured distilled spirits, see section 5271. (Added Pub. L. 85–859, title II, §201, Sept. 2, 1958, 72 Stat. 1370 .)

other_notes.heading: Prior Provisions
other_notes.text: A prior section 5244, act Aug. 16, 1954, ch. 736, 68A Stat. 647 , related to withdrawal of spirits from bonded warehouse on determination of tax, prior to the general revision of this chapter by Pub. L. 85–859. See section 5213 of this title.
